mentioned.quote: we recognize that advanced AI models could lower the barrier to entry for developing chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear (CBRN) or cyber weapons

threshold.note: Benchmark thresholds pp.3-4 are placeholders ('X% (e.g. 30%)') and p.3 says 'We intend to choose the benchmarks and set the thresholds for reducing malicious use risks in a future version' (future/illustrative, C2). p.1 request-level criterion (>100 deaths or >$1B damages) describes which user requests get heightened safeguards, not a model capability or risk level.

response.note: p.1 'Grok would apply heightened safeguards' names no safeguards; p.3 safeguards are ones 'we may potentially utilize'; p.3 'We intend to design into Grok adequate safeguards prior to releasing it' is hedged (intend); p.8 deployment tiers 'we intend to utilize'.

acc_decider.note: nothing to decide for this risk; p.7 'we intend to designate risk owners' is hedged and names no decider.

acc_external.note: p.4 'we will subject Grok to adversarially testing its safeguards utilizing both internal and qualified external red teams' is binding external red teaming of malicious-use safeguards, but this risk has neither a threshold nor a binding response (C5 scope rule, same as C4).

acc_unmet.note: No required response for this risk, so no statement on non-fulfilment.

mentioned.quote: Our aim is to design safeguards into Grok to avoid losing control and thereby avoid unintended catastrophic outcomes when Grok is used.

threshold.note: Thresholds pp.5-6 are placeholders ('<X% lying on MASK (e.g. <50%)', 'Corrigibility Score: >Z (e.g. >0.2)'): illustrations only (C2). p.5 'Our evaluation and mitigation plans for loss of control are not yet fully developed'.

response.note: p.5 'We intend to design into Grok adequate safeguards prior to broad internal or external deployment' is hedged. p.7 incident steps (including temporary shutdown) are introduced as 'including potentially the following steps', which hedges them.

acc_decider.note: nothing to decide for this risk; p.7 risk owner for loss of control is only 'we intend to designate'.

acc_external.note: External red teaming p.4 is in the malicious-use section; no external review of loss-of-control evaluations or safeguards.

acc_unmet.note: No required response for this risk.
